The Accord Party governorship candidate in Oyo State, Oriyomi Hamzat, has met with the wife of former governor Abiola Ajimobi, Ambassador Florence Ajimobi, ahead of the 2027 general elections. Hamzat disclosed this in a post on Sunday, saying their meeting focused on the future of Nigeria and Oyo State as the next general elections approach. He said their discussion also centred on the need for unity in support of President Bola Tinubu’s second-term ambition. “Our conversation was centred on the importance of unity towards the realisation of Asiwaju Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s second-term ambition,” he said. The broadcaster described the meeting as an opportunity for meaningful engagement despite political differences, stressing the need for mutual respect and a shared commitment to the development of the state. “Moments like this remind me that beyond politics and our differences, there is always room for meaningful conversations, mutual respect and a shared commitment for the progress of our people,” he added. Add us to your Preferred Sources Hamzat also reaffirmed his determination to contest the 2027 governorship election, describing his ambition as a collective effort rather than a personal political pursuit. “My commitment to the service of Oyo State as the governor come 2027 remains unwavering, as this is not just my race; but our race,” he said. He said his proposed administration would prioritise inclusive and people-centred governance, adding that his idea of “Governance with a Difference” would ensure that no one was left behind. The Accord Party candidate also assured residents that he would continue to represent their interests in discussions and decisions concerning the state’s future. “I will not step down, nor let down the trust you have placed in me,” he said. Hamzat urged the people of Oyo State to remain hopeful about building a state where everyone counts.
